## Project Overview
**SatTrack3D** - A comprehensive satellite tracking platform with:
1. Real-time satellite tracker dashboard with 3D Earth visualization
2. Satellite pass predictor app for stargazers 
3. Radio ham satellite communication tools
4. Educational space tracking platform
5. Data analysis & visualization tools

**Tech Stack:**
- React + TypeScript + Vite
- Three.js for 3D graphics and Earth visualization  
- Leaflet for 2D mapping
- N2YO API for satellite data
- Responsive design for mobile-first experience
- Modern UI with glassmorphism and space themes
